text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... First, to build a solid foundation,
we will focus on strength training and improving cardiovascular endurance, correct?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I was of the exact same mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I will give it my utmost devotion.
—Excuse me, then.

Ever since signing the contract, we've communicated
thoroughly and training has progressed smoothly.
And yet...
A short while later, during our scheduled break...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*sip... sip... sip...*
—...Phew.
...This right here is the hardest part!!

There's an awkward tension hanging in the air.
I have to break this silence somehow—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes?

...I had no idea what to say, and when I finally
forced something out, it sounded terribly awkward...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As you can see, my training has been
progressing without issue, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Could it be that I have fallen short in some regard...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If so, please do not hesitate to tell me.
I shall make every effort to improve.
choice_data_list: Ah, no, that's not what I meant at all...!

text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah took my words completely literally. But that wasn't
what I was getting at—it was just small talk, a casual check-in...
choice_data_list: A-Anyway, as long as you're feeling good, that's what matters...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes.
That is... good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, what about you, Trainer?
Are you... doing well?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If so, then I am glad.

Oh no, now I've made her worry about me.
I need to handle this properly like an adult—
(*beep beep beep, beep beep beep*)
—Just as I thought that, the timer signaling the end of the break went off.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It appears our time is up.
Shall we resume training?
choice_data_list: R-Right, let's get back to it...!

text_block_list.text:
With the lingering awkwardness still in the air, we resumed training.
I feel like I failed to help her properly rest and recharge...
choice_data_list: (I really need to work on this going forward...)
(I really need to figure this out going forward...)

text_block_list.text:
I was painfully reminded of my own weakness—my complete lack of small-talk skills.
This is a challenge I'll definitely have to overcome...
